integrity: The attached analytic proof specifies critical assumptions and limits; numerical checks corroborate and are not used as infinite proof. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact results apply only to the signed occupation observable under symmetric two-site conditional Poisson resets on the infinite homogeneous nearest-neighbour chain. No entire-generator spectral gap, non-Poisson renewal theorem or finite-system precision certificate is asserted. General-renewal priority remains an independent verification risk.
title: Distance-dependent Zeno memory in a conditionally reset quantum chain
